verdict.rationale: Firstbase advertises vendor-run automated services, such as continuous book reconciliation, automated sales-tax filings and payments, nexus monitoring, and annual report filing. There is no evidence that users can define or configure their own background automations or workflows. These built-in managed-service automations are an adjacent feature, not the user-configurable automation capability the story describes, and probes found no public API spec or llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
